final: **Task complete.** The bug was in the regex pattern: `.+` is greedy and matches from the first `[` to the LAST `]`, swallowing text between tags. Changing it to `.+?` makes it non-greedy, so it matches the shortest string between each pair of brackets, correctly extracting individual tags. All tests now pass.
